title: These 4 Businesses Have the Potential to Make You Rich! | 4 Experts | G2G
creator: Rahul Jain
summary: Rahul Jain hosts this Good to Great collaboration podcast with four operators, each breaking down a business model, its start-up cost and unit economics. It contains no stock recommendations. Kartik Kapoor explains Airbnb rental arbitrage: take a fully furnished metro property on an 11-month lease — about ₹2.5 lakh all-in in Delhi at ₹40,000-50,000 rent — list at about ₹4,000 a night, and at 20 booked days earn about ₹80,000 against roughly ₹52,000 of rent and overheads, leaving about ₹28,000 a month. Sourcing is outsourced to local brokers, legality rests on an owner NOC, and new listings get a 45-60 day algorithm boost. Mohit Singh covers EV charging: India has only 27,000-28,000 chargers, about one per 235 EVs versus a global average of one per 7.5, with EV penetration up from 0.8% in 2021 to 8.3% in 2026. A franchise setup costs ₹15-50 lakh excluding land, buys power at ₹10-11 a unit and sells at ₹18-20; a 60kW charger used four hours a day implies roughly ₹72,000 a month gross margin and about 2.5 years payback at ₹15 lakh, though he advises higher-wattage, upgradeable kit. UClean laundry needs ₹20-25 lakh plus working capital, runs at about 80% gross margin, breaks even near ₹1.5 lakh monthly sales in 3-4 months, and a mature store can keep 35-40%. Ishaan Suri closes with dropshipping: no inventory, supplier ships direct, and on a ₹500 order roughly ₹400 is product, ads, shipping and returns, leaving 15-20% net. Company names are examples only — no ticker or price call.
